title: NeuroFlow CFD
summary: A healthcare AI platform assessing cerebral aneurysm rupture risk by combining CFD simulation with a learned risk model.
challenges: Mesh generation from noisy clinical DICOM data was the single largest source of pipeline failures early on — imaging artifacts produced non-manifold geometry that crashed the CFD solver silently.
lessons: Validating mesh quality before simulation, not after, cut failed runs by most of what was previously lost to downstream solver crashes.
futureWork: Prospective multi-center validation, and extending beyond middle cerebral artery aneurysms.

body.raw:
## What it is

NeuroFlow CFD turns a manual, specialist-only rupture-risk read into a structured, reproducible pipeline: simulate blood flow through the patient's aneurysm geometry, extract hemodynamic features, and score risk.

## Where the depth is

The research paper covers the modeling methodology and its limitations in full; this page is the artifact record — what was built, what broke, and what's next.
